name: 刘清华

papers: A signaling pathway for transcriptional regulation of sleep amount in mice.
Kinase signaling pathway regulates sleep quantity and depth through a distinct population of excitatory neurons.
Regulation of sleep quantity and intensity by long and short isoforms of SLEEPY kinase.
Somatic genetics analysis of sleep in adult mice.
Posterior subthalamic nucleus (PSTh) mediates innate fear-associated hypothermia in mice.
Thiazaline-related fear stimuli orchestrate hypothermia and anti-hypoxia via sensory TRPA1 activation.
Hyper-activation of mPFC underlies specific traumatic stress-induced sleep-wake EEG disturbances.
Quantitative phosphoproteomic analysis of the molecular substrates of sleep need.
Large-scale forward genetics screening identifies Trpa1 as a chemosensor for predator odor-evoked innate fear behaviors.
Forward- genetics analysis of sleep in randomly mutagenized mice.
TAF11 assembles RISC loading complex to enhance RNAi efficiency.
Phosphorylation of the human micro-RNA generating complex mediates MAPK/Erk signaling.
C3PO, an endoribonuclease that promotes RNAi by facilitating RISC activation.
R2D2, a bridge between the initiation and effector steps of the Drosophila RNAi pathway.
Chk1 is an essential kinase that is regulated by Atr and required for the G2/M DNA damage checkpoint.
The univector plasmid-fusion system, a method for rapid construction of recombinant DNA without restriction enzymes.
paper_description: 通过定量蛋白质组学和磷酸化蛋白质组学比较，确定了80个睡眠需求指标的磷酸化蛋白(SNIPPs)。
发现了TRPA1作为一种新型化学传感器，可感受捕食者气味从而诱发先天恐惧行为。
开发了一种新型成年小鼠大脑嵌合(ABC)表达/敲除系统，用于体细胞遗传学分析。
首次进行“恐惧”的正向遗传学筛选，鉴定出“恐惧型”和“无惧型”突变小鼠。
利用正向遗传学筛选鉴定出有明显睡眠异常的突变小鼠，如“嗜睡型”突变和“无梦型”突变。
